description: SHED open railway data inventory provides SHED's curated inventory of railway network, timetable, location-code and passenger-demand data. The provider is SHED project. Geographical and temporal coverage: The collection focuses on Great Britain and links source systems with different dates and access terms. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence: not stated for the inventory; the listed datasets carry their own licences (mostly OGL-UK-3.0 for Network Rail open data). The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: This is a secondary guide to sources, not a unified dataset. Availability of each linked source was not rechecked. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
